prompt.review: independent review round 2 (worktree MINERvA-OmniFold-s5c-review2 at 4bdfa75e), finding 1, HIGH
prompt.defect: amendment 3's linear allowance b_rel = |mean| + 2 SE is added for EVERY functional, including the 65 with no detectable bias (|mean| < 2 SE), whose allowance is pure noise floor. Measured b_rel*|f|/sigma: min 0.40, median 1.23, max 12.5. Predicted nominal-truth coverage with the observed bias: '68%' median 0.58 -> 0.93 (min 0.84), '95%' median 0.90 -> 0.993 (min 0.98). The gate is lower-bound only, so the intervals would pass by construction and their labels would no longer describe them.

revision.interval_construction: f = f_hat / (1 + beta_f); 68%: f +- sqrt(sigma_f^2 + (se_f * f)^2); 95%: f +- 1.96 sqrt(sigma_f^2 + (se_f * f)^2). sigma_f is unchanged (Tier-S bootstrap).
revision.beta_and_se: docs/orchestration/state/s5c/d1/bias_correction.json, produced by nd-unfolding/s5c_bias_correction.py from d1/d1_summary.json group split_F2 (the same nine nominal-truth development experiments and the same mean and standard error that amendment 3 used: |beta| + 2 se reproduces its b_rel to 0.0). Every functional is corrected; there is no selection threshold. max |beta| 4.11%, median |beta| 0.12%, median se 0.044%, max se 0.28%.
revision.why_a_correction_not_an_allowance: a known deterministic bias is removed rather than covered, so the widths change only by the correction's own standard error and the 68%/95% labels keep their meaning; an interval that is still biased (a correction that does not transfer) undercovers and fails the unchanged gate, so the test keeps its power.
revision.independence_statement: beta is estimated ONLY at nominal truth from development seeds. At the nominal grid point the validation measures the coverage of the corrected estimator with fresh seeds (the correction's estimation noise is carried by se). The E_avail-tilt and q3-conditional points test whether a nominal-derived correction transfers under truth departures. Limitations stated with any result: q3_given_eavail_w preserves the (E_avail, W) marginal by construction, so for the M1 (E_avail, W) functionals its truth equals nominal; the E_avail tilt is +-10%.

futility_rule: amendment 3's rule, unchanged, evaluated under this construction (nd-unfolding/s5c_futility_watch.sh)
reported_not_gated: per (functional, grid point): coverage point estimates, one-sided CP upper bounds at the gate level, and the median half-width over sigma, so that over-coverage (for example from a conservative sigma) is visible beside the lower-bound gate
unchanged: functionals, grid, seeds, n = 4,000 per point, the gate thresholds and their Bonferroni correction, sigma, every amendment-2 correction, and amendment 3's futility rule
what_revision_2_cannot_establish: that the analysis's purity background method is unbiased (it is not); the size of the bias on real data (it depends on how well the MC background shape describes nature) or the validity of applying this correction to data; total (statistical + systematic) coverage (Tier T). A failure of this revision exhausts F2's development revisions (plan section 6).
